description: Query cryptographically verified attributes from Lemma. Use this as the primary tool for finding documents whose attributes match given conditions (e.g., "subject's birthYear lt 2008"). Returns { results: Array<{ docHash, schema, issuerId, subjectId, attributes, isVerified, proof?: { status, circuitId, chainId }, disclosure? }>, hasMore }. The MCP layer enriches each item with an `isVerified` flag derived from `proof.status` (true when status is 'verified' or 'onchain-verified'). Use lemma_get_proof_status to monitor a specific proof; use lemma_get_schema to interpret the keys returned in `attributes`.

name.description: Attribute key as defined by the schema.

operator.description: Comparison operator. Defaults to eq when omitted. 'in' takes an array value; 'contains' is substring/array-element match.

value.description: Comparison target value. Type depends on the schema's attribute definition. For 'in', pass an array.

chainIds.description: Restrict results to attributes verified on these chain IDs (EVM).

limit.description: Max results per page (1–200). Defaults to API server default (50).

offset.description: Pagination offset. Pair with `hasMore` in the response to walk pages.

schemas.description: Restrict results to documents conforming to these schema IDs.

name: lemma_query_verified_attributes

hasMore.description: True when more results exist beyond this page; pair with `offset` to walk pages.

results.description: Result set; each item has been MCP-enriched with `isVerified`.

attributes.description: Attribute key/value pairs as defined by the schema.

chainId.description: EVM chain ID, if anchored on-chain.

isVerified.description: MCP-layer flag — true when proof.status is 'verified' or 'onchain-verified'. Prefer this over raw status for boolean checks.

schema.description: Schema ID this document conforms to.
